description.value: Alarm below the Shield: Objective: establish a safe civilian evacuation corridor. Show the obsolete shelter map and ferry demand; reroute ammunition or open the coastal ramp. Delay traps patients.
The Air Is Not Fuel: Objective: verify civilian air ownership. Compare the duplicate ledger with canister seals or make a witnessed pressure test. Delay permits armed convoy departure.

Someone Lives in the Wreck: Objective: stop unsafe salvage. Listen to cabin replies or inspect intact life support; isolate the cutting rig while keeping the core powered. Delay cuts an occupied section.
Ferries before Batteries: Objective: clear the shared lift. Negotiate cargo priority or manually release its jammed hoist with reactor expense. Delay strands the medical shelter.
The Neutral Bay: Objective: protect oxygen production. Clear armed frames from maintenance or move inspection into the transfer ring. Delay reduces air available for the vote.
Wake without Weapons: Objective: ask the sleeping crew for consent. Use the unarmed access key or transmit the wake protocol; weapons stay isolated. Delay lets a rival claim abandoned status.
A Narrow Firing Arc: Objective: redirect the coastal threat. Mark no-fire limits and use low-power lures or shield the ferry route while drawing it seaward. Delay damages the relay.
Canisters in Public: Objective: expose quota fraud safely. Count air with habitat witnesses or escort the clerk through neutral repairs. Delay leaves civilian ownership disputed.
The Price of Scrap: Objective: settle the rival claim without stripping living cabins. Offer verified unoccupied hull or a witnessed deferred debt. Delay brings a claim cutter.
The Pylon Choice: Objective: keep evacuation open before defense fires. Bypass the relay for reduced field strength or take the slower coastal escort. Delay closes the narrow-shot window.
A Charter for Breath: Objective: distribute air without forced military service. Agree to public quotas and an appeals path or temporary shared custody. Delay exhausts the waiting habitat.
Tow a Living Giant: Objective: move the frame on terms its crew accepts. Negotiate the signal yard crossing or brace safely until morning. Delay overheats exposed support rigs.
The Last Shelter Count: Objective: account for all civilians before the shot. Reconcile manifests or send a rescue frame to the missing shelter. Delay permits command's obsolete order.
Independent Docking: Objective: secure a neutral future air corridor. Test the agreed charter against a live convoy and remove armed oversight. Delay revives requisition priority.
The Second Waking: Objective: extend occupied protections to the neighboring giant. Relay the charter or offer an unarmed departure corridor. Delay risks two giants colliding.

Repair after the Alarm: Objective: record the actual cost of defending the city. Assign levee repairs and shelter restitution; reduce remaining battery capacity if needed. Delay leaves lower streets flooded.
Habitat Ledger: Objective: verify air deliveries and civilian choice. Record each habitat's actual reserve and a visible appeal; let a minority retain independent custody. Delay hides a new shortage.
What the Commons Keep: Objective: define consensual salvage and crew autonomy. Mark powered exclusions and unoccupied claims; living frames choose their route. Delay starts the next scrap dispute.
False Shelter Lock: gates close in the lower district; open a safe lane or publicly change the evacuation order.
Missing Air Count: the convoy's civilian tally is short; witness inspection before armed docking begins.
Cabin Reply: a wreck assumed empty answers; stop cutting or isolate the endangered section.
Ferry Lift Jam: ammunition blocks the evacuation lift; reroute cargo or spend reactor on a manual release.
Fuel Label Challenge: a clerk identifies mislabeled canisters; compare originals or pressure-test a sample.
Forged Scrap Tag: a salvage rival declares occupied cabins abandoned; produce the wake record or escort a witness.
Shield Pulse Surge: a maximum shot will draw a second threat; narrow the arc or move the target into an empty basin.
Plant Alarm: armed docking shakes the oxygen pumps; require neutral repairs or split the convoy outside.
Core Heat Rise: cutting tools overload life support; cool the core or pause salvage under guard.
Public Target Map: residents demand the firing limits; disclose the safe arc or agree to civilian marking crews.
Dock Seal Dispute: both military orders conflict; use a witnessed count or negotiate a shared temporary warrant.
Second Frame Answer: a neighboring wreck wakes; relay the commons charter or provide an unarmed departure route.
Shelter Stair Collapse: patients cannot use the stairs; secure the ferry ramp or spend time carrying them individually.
Pressure Window: the canisters can be tested now; assign a diver or trust a public cross-check of seals.
Memory Alarm: a abandoned tag triggers the sentry; remove it or replay the occupied-cabin protocol.
Rainfront Arrival: radar loses the threat; use low-power beacons or send a exposed observer frame.
Civilian Vote: habitats debate the charter; show actual air reserves or guarantee a neutral repair crew.
Salvage Debt Call: a rival demands promised scrap; offer verified unoccupied hull or repay later under witness.
Pylon Break: the ferry field flickers; bypass the relay or escort boats through a slower coastal route.
Convoy Escape Order: a officer orders departure with the air; challenge authority or block the fuel lane without firing.
Coolant Offer: an old pilot brings supplies; record the debt or seek a slower free repair.
Threat Turns Inland: the lure overshoots; move the beacon or lower the shield under a rescue escort.
Pump Crew Walkout: maintenance refuses armed oversight; clear the bay or demonstrate an enforceable neutral corridor.
Cabin Consent: woken crew rejects the tow plan; adapt the route or keep the giant safely stationary.
Final Evacuation Count: a shelter remains missing; verify ferry manifests before any large shot.
Air Sharing Deadline: the habitats need a signed distribution order; publish quotas or delay military transfers.
Giant Departure: the safe yard is crowded; negotiate right of passage or brace the wreck until morning.
Aftershock Flood: the seawall leaks after the narrow shot; share repair frames or evacuate the lower streets.
Quota Witness Arrives: the duplicate ledger becomes public; protect the clerk and establish a visible appeals process.
Commons Claims: salvagers ask what remains available; mark occupied exclusions and agree to monitored future salvage.
